metadata.title: Master Services Agreement
metadata.payment_terms: Undisputed invoices due within 30 days after receipt.

obligations.title: Pay invoices
obligations.description: Pay each undisputed invoice within 30 days after receipt.
obligations.source_text: Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 30 days after receipt.

obligations.title: Give termination notice
obligations.description: Give 60 days written notice before termination for convenience.
obligations.source_text: Either party may terminate for convenience by giving the other party 60 days written notice.

risks.why_it_matters: Exposure is uncapped and includes consequential damages.
risks.recommendation: Have counsel review and negotiate a liability cap.
risks.source_text: Provider's liability for all claims is unlimited, including indirect and consequential damages.

qa.question: When are invoices due?
qa.answer: Undisputed invoices are due within 30 days after receipt.

obligations.title: Return or destroy confidential information
obligations.description: Return or destroy confidential information within 10 days after request.
obligations.source_text: Each receiving party must return or destroy confidential information within 10 days after a written request from the disclosing party.

risks.description: Archival copies may be retained indefinitely.
risks.source_text: A receiving party may retain archival copies indefinitely when required by its internal backup policy.

qa.question: When must confidential information be returned?
qa.answer: Within 10 days after a written request.

qa.question: Can either party terminate for convenience?

metadata.title: Cloud Subscription Agreement
metadata.payment_terms: Annual fees due in advance within 15 days of invoice.

obligations.title: Provide service credit report
obligations.description: Provide a service credit report after each affected month.
obligations.recurring_frequency: within 5 business days after each affected month
obligations.source_text: Supplier shall maintain 99.9% monthly availability and provide a service credit report to Subscriber within 5 business days after each affected month.

risks.description: The agreement renews unless timely notice is given.
risks.why_it_matters: A missed deadline creates another one-year term.
risks.recommendation: Calendar the notice deadline and review renewal intent.
risks.source_text: The subscription renews automatically for one-year terms unless either party gives notice by January 30, 2027.
